method_fidelity_checklist.definition: A unified autoregressive framework that uses separate visual encoders for understanding and generation tasks, both feeding into a shared Transformer backbone
key_structural_ingredients: Understanding encoder: SigLIP-style contrastive encoder with sigmoid loss
Generation encoder: LlamaGen-style VQ tokenizer (downsample=16, codebook=16384, dim=8)
Unified backbone: Autoregressive Transformer with QK-norm and z-loss
Modality routing: Special tokens to signal understanding vs generation pathway
assumptions: Understanding and generation have different optimal visual representations
Contrastive training preserves semantic detail better than discrete tokenization
Discrete tokenization provides better reconstruction quality than continuous features
Decoupling eliminates modality competition in softmax
invariants: Both encoders process the same input image
Both pathways share the same Transformer backbone
Autoregressive next-token prediction paradigm is maintained
Training follows staged approach: pre-train encoders, then backbone, then SFT
non_negotiable_steps: Separate understanding and generation encoders must exist
Encoders must be task-specialized (contrastive vs VQ)
Shared backbone must support both text and image token generation
QK-norm must be applied for training stability
deviations: Benchmark numbers are extrapolated from published results rather than empirically measured - this is a conceptual framework analysis, not an empirical training run
OCR demo shows hypothesized outputs rather than actual model inference results
Semantic understanding demo shows hypothesized interpretations rather than actual model outputs
method_fidelity_checklist.deviation_reasons: Computational resources insufficient for training 3B+ parameter models; task is framework design and analysis, not full empirical validation
